title: apply --push names a delivery sent as a merge request as such, not as pushed to origin/main
goal: querylog.py apply --push prints that its commit went as the merge request of branch code/<sha> and origin/main did not move when kbgit.py sync sent it by the code lane, instead of 'pushed <sha> to origin/main' (run 20261012T134205Z-9997a0f4 in SP-kwi4ilty), so an orchestrator knows to wait for the merge before reading the store
